Deepika’s Brace Powers India to 3-2 Comeback Win Over Uruguay | FIH Hockey Women’s Nations Cup Highlights
The Indian Women’s Hockey Team staged another impressive comeback, rallying from behind to defeat Uruguay 3-2 in their final Pool A match of the FIH Hockey Women’s Nations Cup New Zealand 2025-26 at the North Harbour National Hockey Centre in Auckland. Deepika starred with a brace, including a dramatic late winner, while Deepika Soreng also found the net as India secured their third consecutive victory. The unbeaten run helped India finish on top of Pool A and advance to the semi-finals.
